description: Defines the interface for VariableHooks in PyTorch's autograd system, including virtual methods for tensor data access, hooks management, and autograd metadata.

classes.name: VariableHooksInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for variable hooks in autograd, providing methods for tensor data access, hooks registration, and autograd metadata management.

classes.name: VariableHooksRegisterer
classes.description: Helper class to register variable hooks upon instantiation.

methods.name: tensor_data
methods.description: Returns the tensor data for a given tensor base.

methods.name: variable_data
methods.description: Returns the variable data for a given tensor base.

methods.name: grad_fn
methods.description: Returns the gradient function node associated with a tensor.

methods.name: _register_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook function for a tensor.

methods.name: remove_hook
methods.description: Removes a registered hook from a tensor.

methods.name: is_view
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a view.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Returns the base tensor of a view.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of a tensor.

methods.name: is_leaf
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a leaf node in autograd.

methods.name: output_nr
methods.description: Returns the output number of a tensor.

methods.name: set_data
methods.description: Sets the data of a tensor.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns the data of a tensor.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Returns the version of a tensor.

methods.name: retain_grad
methods.description: Retains gradient for a tensor.

methods.name: retains_grad
methods.description: Checks if a tensor retains gradient.

methods.name: _backward
methods.description: Performs backward operation on a tensor.

methods.name: requires_grad_
methods.description: Sets whether a tensor requires gradient.

methods.name: basic_autograd_not_implemented_fallback
methods.description: Fallback for autograd functions not implemented.

methods.name: grad_dtype
methods.description: Returns the gradient data type of a tensor.

methods.name: set_grad_dtype
methods.description: Sets the gradient data type of a tensor.
